title: How Chris Pulver Achieves an 85% Win Rate With 0DTE Options
summary: Chris Pulver (options educator, 'Practical Options' course) runs a flexible defined-risk 0DTE SPX/XSP book: a ~10-delta iron condor sized inside a gap-adjusted expected-move box, a broken-wing-butterfly defense just inside it, and standalone 'profit-trap' butterflies pinned at intraday gamma (TanukiTrade HVL) levels. Claims ~85-89.6% win rate and +27%/2025, +15.3%-YTD/2026 — but it's an intraday discretionary day-trade whose ~85% headline is, to the decimal, the breakeven win rate of his own iron condor. Write-up: strategies/pulver_0dte.md (conviction 2/5).
